text: i think that apptick line though happens because i was doing: brush size 29 and i added up to 28 chunks and then was just wasd painting. which, when that is happening, i do drop to like 29-20-18 fps, so, that is actually something if possible to find a performance gain that is probably a great start since otherwise it just sits at 240 fps

events.text: profiling: paint-while-WASD drops 240fps to ~18; apptick jsTick=63ms during strokes at 28 chunks / 4.2M bush rows

resolution: The requested performance gain for paint-time fps drops (29-20-18fps while WASD-painting) was found and shipped under req_2856 (same root cause, clarified repro): unconditional dirty flags in engine.zig paintGlobalCell made no-op re-stamps of unchanged cells regenerate the entire foliage preview every frame. Change-gated flora/tile/zone stamps, commit 0d049271e, rebuild required. If drag-painting new ground still drops fps after retest, the follow-up lever is moving regenPaintFoliage off the frame thread (pose_mailbox pattern, req_2845) and/or per-chunk incremental regen.
